caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden mallet centered on a plain, beige background. The mallet is vertically oriented with the handle at the top and the striking head at the bottom. The handle is cylindrical and tapers slightly as it meets the head, which flares out in a wider, bell-like shape. Both parts of the mallet show detailed wood grain patterns in shades of light to medium brown. There are no other objects present, and the drawing uses shading to give dimensionality to the mallet, suggesting a three-dimensional form. The artist's signature, "G.W. Dawson," is written near the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Potato Masher
